title: Coherence graph edge
description: A constraint between surfaces that must hold simultaneously. Most real detections are a broken edge rather than a wrong value, so edges are first-class rows with their own owner.

members.description: Surface ledger ids bound by this constraint.

constraint.description: The relation in plain language, e.g. 'navigator.platform, UA OS token and Client Hints platform must name the same OS'.

check.description: Executable predicate over a collected fingerprint, used by the V3 conformance runner.

severity.description: fatal: a violation is decisive on its own. strong: decisive when corroborated. weak: never sufficient alone. Mirrors the ruling algebra so weak signals cannot accumulate into false certainty.
